name: Neck Extension
instructions: Sit tall and place your hands behind your head for light resistance, or lie face down with your head off a bench.
Slowly lift your head back against the resistance.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A gentle neck-extension exercise for the muscles at the back of the neck.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
commonMistakes: Craning the head too far back
safetyNotes: Use very light resistance; stop with dizziness, tingling or pain.
